hint.first_approval.body: This is an approval request. Puspa never spends money or changes anything outside chat without asking you first. Only approve what you recognise; you can always refuse.
hint.first_approval.title: Puspa asks before acting
hint.first_billing_row.body: Puspa just recorded your first usage: tokens and cost for one turn. The Insights screen totals them per day, per model, and per tool, with nothing estimated or rounded.
hint.first_billing_row.title: Your first usage is recorded
hint.first_costly_task.body: This task cost as much as the per-task ceiling ({ceiling}). The Insights screen shows where the tokens went, per model and per tool, so you can see what is expensive.
hint.first_costly_task.title: That task hit the cost ceiling
hint.first_memory_use.body: Puspa just used its memory for the first time. Facts you confirm are stored on your own machine and shown on the Memory screen, where you can correct or delete them.
hint.first_memory_use.title: Puspa remembers what you told it
hint.first_modules_visit.body: This is the Modules screen. One module adds one Puspa capability, for example price checks or bill reminders. You can switch modules on and off here; nothing runs until you ask for it.
hint.first_modules_visit.title: Modules add capabilities
